title: Steps to create Own Account Transfer

steps.text: Login to the mobile application, Land on accounts dashboard (account landed in the debit account number) and click Transfer

Enter amount and click Next  
 a. If credit amount currency is different than debit amount currency, customer can select payment currency from a drop-down list

Enter description (optional field)  
 a. Confirm: proceed with transfer 
 b. Back arrow to edit transfer details
